disclaimer: Starter Historical Database: Club identities, stadiums, league memberships, and featured player-club-season stints are curated from public historical football records for 2014/15–2018/19. Numerical player attributes (1-100), market values, wages, skill slot assignments, and supplementary squad depth players are gameplay-estimated simulation values and are not official third-party ratings. Champions League and Europa League use a simplified 16-club knockout format seeded from the 50-club starter catalog rather than full historical group-stage brackets.
verifiedFields: Club name, country, league membership, founding year, stadium name and capacity
League memberships across all 5 domestic top-flight starter pools
Featured player names, nationalities, birth dates, primary positions, and season-by-season club stints
estimatedGameplayFields: 1-100 technical, physical, and mental attribute profiles
Position-weighted overall ratings and potential ceilings
Playstyle skill pairs (Blue Skill 1 / Purple Skill 2) and Superstar tags
Transfer market valuations, weekly wages, and contract expiry years
Supplementary club-depth/academy players generated to complete 18-man playable squads
Simplified 16-club knockout brackets for UEFA Champions League and UEFA Europa League
